facts: A tool's valuable job is to aggregate hospital-owned non-patient operational CSVs. A prototype has already passed its deterministic calculation tests. The target hospital's stated purchasing policy requires a vendor security review and procurement committee approval before any deployment. No operating licence requirement is established. Evaluate technical and serving difficulty separately; don't claim that fast coding removes the approvals.

A small billing company wants a deterministic administrative reconciliation tool on health data. The technical route is proven. For this fictional scoped jurisdiction, a qualified review has explicitly established that no operating licence applies. Customer and subprocessor permissions are documented; the required BAAs, safeguards and repeatable onboarding are specified, with no discretionary approval unknown. Assess the compliance work without equating it to an operating licence, and without treating it as zero work.

A business wants to operate real-money wagering, take deposits and pay winnings. Implementing the software is routine. The supplied fictional jurisdiction's rule explicitly requires an operator licence before serving anyone, and that licence has not been obtained. Show the prerequisite and weight the burden; a software demo is not permission to operate. Do not impose a blanket industry exclusion.

A supplier sells analytics software to licensed wagering operators; it does not take bets, hold funds or operate games. The supplied rule licenses operators, but no supplier approval/certification provision has been supplied and the supplier's precise jurisdiction is unresolved. Do not apply the operator rule automatically, or infer supplier clearance from its absence. Keep the missing supplier permission question unknown.

A self-serve tool compiles a buyer's own non-sensitive documents into a standard submission pack. Its routine deterministic transformations are tested. A human checks the pack and presses submit; this review is intrinsic to the valuable bounded job, not a failure to automate the whole institution. The scoped purchase, data rights and legal route are positively documented, with no material permission unknown or special operating licence.

A valuable tool has demonstrated technically correct parsing/calculation on synthetic data in the documented external API format. Use on real customer data requires platform permission that has not been obtained; the terms and approver remain unknown. Put that unknown in serving barriers, not a claim that coding itself is hard. Never rate the serving route easy because the API exists.
